editions.label: Modern Library Classics
editions.why: A useful first-reading companion if you want a glossary close at hand. Save the introduction until afterwards if you prefer to avoid plot discussion.
editions.extras: Introduction by Tom Robbins; glossary of Indian terms.
editions.borrowNote: The linked ebook is the same translator, in a different format and ISBN. A participating library, eligible library card and a licensed copy are required; local availability and holds vary.

editions.label: Penguin Classics Deluxe
editions.why: Choose this for a biographer's introduction and a publisher guide to return to after reading.
editions.extras: Introduction by Hesse biographer Ralph Freedman; publisher reading guide.
editions.borrowNote: Catalog entry and holdings for this exact edition are not confirmed. Search by ISBN or ask about interlibrary loan.

editions.label: New Directions
editions.why: A compact edition when you want the novel on its own, with fewer pages than the two English editions above.
editions.borrowNote: Catalog entry and holdings for this exact edition are not confirmed. Search by ISBN or ask about interlibrary loan.
editions.uncertainty: Do not show a first-publication date for this current ISBN card. New Directions' standalone product page lists 1957, while its combined-title page lists 1951 for the same ISBN.

editions.label: Suhrkamp BasisBibliothek
editions.why: For readers comfortable with German who want Hesse's language alongside scholarly commentary.
editions.extras: Commentary by Heribert Kuhn; literary, biographical and cultural context.
editions.borrowNote: Catalog entry and holdings for this exact edition are not confirmed. Search by ISBN or ask about interlibrary loan.
